/*pplx_space_internal_api_server::published_state:478*/ WITH scope AS (
             SELECT DISTINCT input.template_name, COALESCE(input.content_hash, $3) AS content_hash
             FROM jsonb_to_recordset($2::jsonb) AS input(
                 template_name TEXT,
                 content_hash TEXT
             )
         ),
         input AS (
             SELECT *
             FROM jsonb_to_recordset($2::jsonb) AS input(
                 template_name TEXT,
                 content_hash TEXT,
                 execution_components JSONB
             )
         ),
         incoming AS (
             SELECT input.template_name, COALESCE(input.content_hash, $4) AS content_hash,
                    component.kind, component.role_key, component.version,
                    component.digest, component.format
             FROM input
             JOIN node_template_inventory inventory
               ON inventory.node_id = $1
              AND inventory.template_name = input.template_name
              AND inventory.content_hash = COALESCE(input.content_hash, $5)
             CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_to_recordset(
                 COALESCE(input.execution_components, $6::jsonb)
             ) AS component(
                 kind TEXT, role_key TEXT, version TEXT, digest TEXT, format TEXT
             )
         )
         DELETE FROM node_template_components component
         USING scope
         WHERE component.node_id = $1
           AND component.template_name = scope.template_name
           AND component.content_hash = scope.content_hash
           AND NOT EXISTS (
               SELECT $7
               FROM incoming
               WHERE incoming.template_name = component.template_name
                 AND incoming.content_hash = component.content_hash
                 AND incoming.kind = component.kind
                 AND incoming.role_key = component.role_key
           )

/*pplx_space_internal_api_server::node_publish::store::failure_episodes:85*/ UPDATE node_facet_observed_status observed
         SET observed_payload = COALESCE(observed.observed_payload, $5::JSONB)
                                    - $4::TEXT,
             observed_at = NOW(),
             updated_at = NOW()
         FROM jsonb_to_recordset($2::JSONB) AS input(
             sandbox_id UUID,
             status TEXT,
             state_degraded BOOLEAN,
             execution_generation BIGINT,
             pod_uid TEXT,
             activation_attempt_id TEXT
         )
         JOIN sandboxes s
           ON s.id = input.sandbox_id
         LEFT JOIN sandbox_direct_route_identities direct_route
           ON direct_route.sandbox_id = s.id
         WHERE COALESCE(direct_route.current_node_id, s.active_node_id) = $1
           AND observed.node_id = $1
           AND observed.facet = $3
           AND observed.element = input.sandbox_id::TEXT
           AND (
               LOWER(TRIM(input.status)) IS DISTINCT FROM $6
               OR (
                   NOT input.state_degraded
                   AND input.execution_generation IS NULL
               )
           )
           AND observed.observed_payload ? $4::TEXT

/*pplx_space_internal_api_server::node_publish::store::sandbox_facet_observations:33*/ WITH input AS (
             SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset($2::JSONB) AS input(
                 sandbox_id UUID, status TEXT, execution_generation BIGINT,
                 pod_uid TEXT, current_local_artifact_id UUID,
                 current_local_artifact_kind TEXT, current_local_artifact_origin TEXT
             )
         ), observation AS (
             SELECT input.sandbox_id,
                    CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(input.status)) = $6
                               AND input.current_local_artifact_id IS NOT NULL
                               AND input.current_local_artifact_kind = $7
                               AND input.current_local_artifact_origin = $8
                         THEN jsonb_build_object($4::TEXT, jsonb_build_object(
                             $9, input.execution_generation,
                             $10, input.pod_uid,
                             $11, input.current_local_artifact_id
                         ))
                         ELSE $12::JSONB END AS payload
               FROM input
               JOIN sandboxes s ON s.id = input.sandbox_id
               JOIN sandbox_k8s_executions e ON e.sandbox_id = s.id
              WHERE s.active_node_id = $1
                AND s.managed_by = $5
                AND s.lifecycle = $13
                AND e.active AND e.state IN ($14, $15)
                AND e.generation = input.execution_generation
                AND e.pod_uid = input.pod_uid
                AND input.status IS NOT NULL
         )
         INSERT INTO node_facet_observed_status (
             node_id, facet, element, observed_payload, observed_at, updated_at
         )
         SELECT $1, $3, observation.sandbox_id::TEXT, observation.payload, NOW(), NOW()
           FROM observation
          WHERE observation.payload ? $4::TEXT
             OR EXISTS (
                 SELECT $16 FROM node_facet_observed_status prior
                  WHERE prior.node_id = $1 AND prior.facet = $3
                    AND prior.element = observation.sandbox_id::TEXT
                    AND prior.observed_payload ? $4::TEXT
             )
         ON CONFLICT (node_id, facet, element) DO UPDATE
         SET observed_payload = (COALESCE(node_facet_observed_status.observed_payload, $17::JSONB)
                                    - $4::TEXT) || EXCLUDED.observed_payload,
             observed_at = EXCLUDED.observed_at,
             updated_at = NOW()
         WHERE node_facet_observed_status.observed_payload -> $4::TEXT
               IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.observed_payload -> $4::TEXT

/*pplx_space_internal_api_server::sandbox_quarantine_store:408*/ WITH input AS (
             SELECT *

    sandbox_id UUID,

    current_local_artifact_kind TEXT,
    current_local_artifact_origin TEXT,
    execution_generation BIGINT,
    pod_uid TEXT
)
         ), released AS (
             UPDATE sandbox_k8s_executions execution
                SET activation_attempt_id = $4,
                    activation_attempt_expires_at = $5,
                    activation_attempt_target_state = $6,
                    updated_at = NOW()
               FROM sandboxes sandbox, input
              WHERE sandbox.id = execution.sandbox_id
                AND input.sandbox_id = sandbox.id
                AND sandbox.active_node_id = $1
                AND execution.active
                AND execution.generation = input.transition_receipt_execution_generation
                AND execution.activation_attempt_id = input.transition_receipt_activation_attempt_id
                AND execution.route_activation_id IS NOT NULL
                AND execution.activation_attempt_target_state = input.transition_receipt_target_state
                AND input.transition_receipt_kind = $3
                AND LOWER(TRIM(input.status)) = input.transition_receipt_target_state
                AND (
                    (
                        input.transition_receipt_target_state = $7
                        AND LOWER(TRIM(sandbox.lifecycle)) = $8
                    )
                    OR (
                        input.transition_receipt_target_state IN ($9, $10)
                        AND execution.state = $11
                        AND execution.pod_ip IS NOT NULL
                    )
                )
              RETURNING execution.sandbox_id, input.transition_receipt_target_state
         )
         UPDATE sandboxes sandbox
            SET lifecycle = released.transition_receipt_target_state,
                placement = CASE
                    WHEN released.transition_receipt_target_state IN ($12, $13)
                    THEN $14
                    ELSE sandbox.placement
                END
           FROM released
          WHERE sandbox.id = released.sandbox_id
            AND LOWER(TRIM(sandbox.lifecycle)) NOT IN (
                $15, $16, $17, $18, $19, $20
            )
         RETURNING sandbox.id
